value.signature: fn append_effective_successor (& mut self , version : Version , predecessor : Option < & Predecessor > ,) -> Result < bool , StorageError >

review.body: { let span = cli_common :: observation :: scope ("HOST" , "sig:design:storage" , "storage::MemoryStore::append_effective_successor" , & (& version , predecessor) ,) ; let key = (version . family , version . key . clone ()) ; let mut next = History :: new () ; if let Some (rows) = self . history . get (& key) { next . insert (key . clone () , rows . clone ()) ; } let result = classified (append (& mut next , version , predecessor)) ; if result . is_ok () && let Some (rows) = next . remove (& key) { self . history . insert (key , rows) ; } span . finish (& result) ; result }
review.item_premise: Storage accepts public validated carriers and returns complete canonical packages and typed fieldless causes. The private Session is not formatted into public content. Closed SQL selects only schema identity and public history; every statement and decoded result is covered by the positive and sensitive DataRow controls. No storage computation reads observation. Async boundaries enter only when polled. Independent production admission remains held. The relay publishes its fieldless cause before dropping stream halves; storage copies only the requested public chain and uses the private typed statement vocabulary.
